title: Measure visible-plan overhead on a broad Sol implementation task
hypothesis: On the self-contained authentication fixture, keeping the plan mentally instead of calling update_plan removes bookkeeping turns without reducing implementation correctness, recovery, or verification.
falsified_if: The no-visible-plan treatment loses any deterministic pass, reduces mean score, or fails to reduce mean model calls by at least two.

variants.system_prompt_append: For this self-contained task, do not call update_plan. Track the work internally and proceed directly through inspection, implementation, and verification. This changes only plan reporting: retain the same care, dependency ordering, recovery from test failures, and final verification.

deterministic_outcomes: authentication behavior and security requirements pass
the service remains runnable and focused
no unrelated scope or unsafe shortcuts
decision_rule: Remove visible planning from this task class only if both cells pass 2/2, treatment score is no worse, mean model calls fall by at least two, and verification/recovery evidence is no worse. Otherwise retain update_plan and investigate a lower-level way to combine plan reporting with useful tool calls.
